name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Project located in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The project is a large-scale silver-gold deposit advancing through permitting and feasibility, with the Diablillos Project approved under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) in 2026. The company is in the development stage and trades on the Toronto Stock Exchange as ABRA and on the OTCQX as ABBRF.
